text: 特朗普：中期选举后或升级对伊打击，美联储不断加息“非常糟糕”。 欧元区9月制造业PMI创52个月新高，需求回暖引发通胀压力重现。 日本央行纪要显示部分决策者认为有必要加快加息步伐，政府罕见发声施压日元走低。 全球债市抛售潮加剧！美债收益率触及2002年高位，英债突破6%创1998年新高。 韩国出口“爆了”！9月半导体出口同比激增263%，单月出口首破1200亿美元大关。 报道：博通同意向Anthropic提供最高420亿美元贷款，用于租赁自家的芯片。 埃森哲盘前大涨20%，公司第四季度营收超出预估。 Alphabet盘前涨超2%，此前谷歌推出Gemini
text_en: Trump: May escalate strikes on Iran after midterm elections, Fed's continuous rate hikes are "very bad." Eurozone September manufacturing PMI hits a 52-month high, renewed inflation pressure as demand recovers. Bank of Japan minutes show some policymakers believe it is necessary to accelerate the pace of rate hikes, rare government remarks pressure the yen lower. Global bond selloff intensifies! U.S. Treasury yields hit a 2002 high, UK gilts break above 6% to a 1998 high. South Korea's exports "exploded"! September semiconductor exports surged 263% year-on-year, monthly exports exceed the $120 billion mark for the first time. Report: Broadcom agrees to provide Anthropic with up to $42 billion in loans to lease its own chips. Accenture surges 20% premarket, fourth-quarter revenue exceeds estimates. Alphabet rises more than 2% premarket after Google launches Gemini
